dataset_identity.name: ARAUS
dataset_identity.description: Schema-level MOSAIQ representation of one existing ARAUS clip row.

structural_harmonisation.note: Record is represented with the shared MOSAIQ schema-level structure.

semantic_harmonisation.note: Perceptual semantics are limited to ISO 12913 PAQ items and Method A coordinates.

feature_harmonisation.note: Feature records are structurally represented, but extraction methods and distributions are not statistically harmonised.

statistical_harmonisation.note: No label rescaling, distribution matching, domain adaptation, or imputation is performed.

benchmark_split_harmonisation.note: Existing source split fields may be recorded, but this layer does not create MOSAIQ benchmark splits.

checklist.note: Dataset and sample identifiers are represented.
Audio and visual availability are represented with explicit missingness where needed.
ISO 12913 PAQ item semantics are represented under canonical MOSAIQ names.
No benchmark evaluation protocol or split is introduced at this stage.

access.notes: Existing ARAUS derived schema records licence_spdx as Other.
